comment: Independent options.c:optfn_fruit() witness for typed bytes above 0x7F with eight_bit_tty on. Seed 27183059, clock 20570704092210, Monk, the full-menu route and the fruit text were chosen before JavaScript comparison. tty getlin stores each key as one byte; the pair 0xC3 0xA9 forms a UTF-8 sequence while 0xE8 stands alone. nmcpy() keeps PL_FSIZ - 1 = 31 bytes, and bones.c sanitize_name() keeps the high bytes because eight_bit_tty sets wc_eight_bit_input, but turns 0x85, whose low seven bits are a control code, into '.'.
